authority_limit: RDF does not choose a bounded-context subject kind, owner, identity, lifecycle, role, truth, authority or application closed-world policy.
bounded_implication: Resources, referents, IRIs, literals, blank nodes, triple terms, statements, graphs and datasets are distinct constructs; an RDF graph is a symbolic structure rather than a domain conceptual model.
title: RDF 1.2 Concepts and Abstract Data Model

authority_limit: OWL categories and punning do not establish SAN domain kinds, aggregate boundaries, operational lifecycle, assertion authority or member applicability.
bounded_implication: Classes, datatypes, object/data/annotation properties, named/anonymous individuals, literals, axioms and ontologies occupy distinct language positions, with constrained metamodeling.
title: OWL 2 Structural Specification and Functional-Style Syntax

authority_limit: Provenance classification does not prove domain truth, causality, ownership, validity, acceptance or exact operational semantics.
bounded_implication: Entities with fixed aspects, activities occurring over time, responsible agents and generation/usage/invalidation relations are distinct provenance subjects.
title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology

authority_limit: Carrier validation does not choose domain referents, identity, ownership, lifecycle, truth, effects or semantic compatibility.
bounded_implication: JSON instances, schema documents, vocabularies, assertions, annotations, applicators and locations are distinct roles even when all use JSON carriers.
title: JSON Schema Core 2020-12

authority_limit: ODRL does not make every rule a policy, every resource an asset, an offer a grant, or syntax an enforced effect.
bounded_implication: Policies, rules, permissions, prohibitions, duties, assets, parties, actions, constraints, offers and agreements have different normative positions and conflict behavior.
title: ODRL Information Model 2.2

authority_limit: An event envelope does not establish business truth, observation completeness, command intent, state, causal sufficiency or accepted effect.
bounded_implication: An event has context attributes and data describing an occurrence; event envelope, occurrence and payload are separable.
title: CloudEvents Specification

authority_limit: Cryptographic verification is not truth of claims, subject identity, authority for every use, current validity or acceptance.
bounded_implication: Issuer, holder, subject, claims, evidence, status and securing mechanisms occupy distinct roles in a credential ecosystem.
title: Verifiable Credentials Data Model v2.0

authority_limit: A resource representation or status field is not a universal domain aggregate, observation truth, desired-state authority or accepted external effect.
bounded_implication: API resources distinguish desired specification, current status, object identity, generations, conditions and subresources.
title: Kubernetes API Conventions
